title: Women’s quota, delimitation bill to dominate Winter session

ai.summary: The government plans to expand the Lok Sabha to 850 seats via delimitation, aiming for women's reservation in Parliament and state legislatures before 2029 elections, amid opposition protests against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

facts.claim: Winter session of Parliament likely to begin in first week of December
facts.quote: Winter session of Parliament is likely to begin in the first week of December

facts.claim: Bill seeks to increase Lok Sabha’s strength from 543 to 850 seats through delimitation
facts.quote: The bill seeks to increase Lok Sabha’s strength from 543 to a maximum of 850 seats through delimitation

facts.claim: Paving the way for women’s reservation in Parliament and state legislatures before 2029 general elections
facts.quote: paving the way for women’s reservation in Parliament and state legislatures before 2029 general elections

facts.claim: Bill requires a two-thirds majority, or 361 votes in the present 540-member House
facts.quote: The bill requires a two-thirds majority, or 361 votes in the present 540-member House

facts.claim: Ruling NDA has 320 members and needs opposition support
facts.quote: The ruling NDA has 320 members and needs opposition support

facts.claim: Government is confident of securing the numbers
facts.quote: The government is confident of securing the numbers

facts.claim: Bill failed to secure numbers during a special sitting on April 17
facts.quote: The bill failed to secure numbers during a special sitting on April 17

ai.background_note: The government's proposal to expand the Lok Sabha through delimitation, which includes women's reservation, faces opposition protests against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
